'''Vors d'Oesti''' was a member of [[Nym/Legends|Nym]]'s [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Nym formed an alliance with the [[Detritus Satellites]], a group of [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droids]] active in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]]. Nym's Commander Vors d'Oesti and the droid [[X10-700 "Destroyer"]] were the signers of the alliance agreement.<ref name="SWG:AAA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vors d'Oesti was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AAA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vors d'Oesti was mentioned in a document added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]].<ref name="SWG:AAA" />
